# Cyrus Plugins · @cyrusdoyle/dsh-plugins
A plugin collection for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Install this one bundle to get every plugin listed b
elow; each plugin can also be installed on its own.
## Plugins
| Plugin                                                 | npm package                  | What it do
es
| Sessions Insight | `@cyrusdoyle/dsh-sessions-insight` | Opens up what each turn of a Claude Code,
DSH or Codex session actually fed the model: composition, tool calls, compactions, cost. Includes co
nfirmed session deletion. |
## Install
Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer (see `docs/adr/0002-asar-021-is-the-contract.md`). First decide whi
ch profile to install into: the desktop app uses `desktop`, `dsh web` on the command line uses `web`
. Installing into the wrong profile does not error; the plugin just never shows up.
**Install the collection (recommended)** to get every plugin at once; when a plugin is added to the
collection later, upgrading the collection brings it in.

Then **fully quit and reopen** DSH. "Cyrus Plugins" or "Sessions Insight" in the plugin manager mean
quit and reopen** DSH. "Cyrus Plugins" or "Sessions Insight" in the plugin manager means it worked.
> **Pick one of the two.** The collection and the standalone plugin insert the same id into the load
er tree; with both in `dsh.profile.bundles`, DSH fails at boot with `duplicate loader entry id`. Run

`dsh plugin --profile <name> remove` on one before switching to the other.
>
> **Git installs work
for the standalone plugin, not for the collection.** `plugins/sessions-insight/lib/` is committed, s
o the member can be installed straight from this repository without running build scripts — for exam
ple `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Mt-Youya/dsh-plugins#path:/plugins/sessions-insight`, o
r point the plugin manager at a local checkout of that directory. The collection cannot be installed
from Git: its root `dependencies` use `workspace:^`, which is only rewritten to a version number by
`pnpm pack` / publish. Install the collection from npm, or link this checkout as described below.
**Installing from this working tree (developing the collection)**: the desktop plugin manager's "Add
plugin" also accepts a local directory — point it at this checkout's absolute path. DSH records it
as `"@cyrusdoyle/dsh-plugins": "link:<that path>"`: a symlink into your working tree, not a copy, an
d nothing is built for you. The host resolves `lib/index.js` through that link, and `lib/` is gitign
ored, so build it first (the collection embeds the compiled stylesheet, so the CSS step comes first)

## Settings, balance and update checks
The collection embeds the same plugin source as the standalone member (ADR 0009), so its runtime beh
aviour is the Sessions Insight behaviour: read-only insight, the handoff, confirmed session deletion
, plus a settings page and two opt-in utilities.
- **Settings are saved by the Host.** `/api/dsh-sessions-insight/settings` is read-only; the six swi
tches (session overview, Skills tab, cumulative level chart, expand tools by default, balance displa
y, automatic version checks) are written through the Host's configuration form and stored by the Hos

t. The plugin writes no config file.
- **Balance and version checks are off by default.** Turning on
e on — or pressing its button — is the only thing that makes the plugin call out. Outbound traffic i
s limited to two fixed HTTPS endpoints, `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` and `https://registr

y.npmjs.org/@cyrusdoyle%2F.../latest`, with no redirects, no cookies and no caller-controlled URL.
-
**Credentials**: the balance check resolves the credential reference configured for the DeepSeek of
ficial adapter (`apiKeyEnv`, default `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`), then falls back to the signed-in DeepSeek

account. Custom provider references are not followed; the plugin never stores or logs the key.
- **T
he read surface never rewrites source logs.** The only writes are the handoff routes — `handoff/appl
y` delivers a brief through the official `session.create` + `session.prompt`, `handoff/reveal` creat
es or reuses a workspace so an existing DSH session is visible there — and confirmed session deletio
n. `/balance` additionally accepts loopback callers only, because the Host webserver has no site-wid

e auth.
- **Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5+**: the settings page needs the `configForms` client service and
the `plugins.bundle.config` slot introduced in that version.
The plugin README has the full route list, defaults and known limitations.
